name: DBX
summary: Cross-platform database client for 100+ databases with desktop, Docker, CLI, built-in AI SQL assistant and an MCP server.
use_cases: generate SQL from a plain-language description
let AI coding agents query configured databases over MCP
preview Parquet, CSV or JSON files by drag and drop
features: connect to 100+ databases in one tool
AI SQL assistant generating and explaining queries
edit and export query results in data grid

operations.feature: edit and export query results in data grid
operations.goal: In DBX, create a new connection: choose SQLite (under Lightweight), name it pk{nonce}, File Path /home/sbx/pickfit-data/test.db, save. Open a new SQL query editor for that connection, type: SELECT name, qty*7 AS weekly FROM items; and click Run. In the results grid, select all result rows (click a cell then press Ctrl+A), then right-click a selected cell and choose the Copy as CSV option from the context menu (or use the results' Export menu's copy-to-clipboard option for CSV). The results must end up on the clipboard as CSV.
